topic: The anime that correctly predicted a major scientific discovery 10 years early
hook: This anime accurately predicted a scientific discovery 10 years early.
script: This anime accurately predicted a scientific discovery 10 years early. Ghost in the Shell, released in 1995, depicted neural interfaces allowing direct human-computer connection. Brain-computer interface technology enabling paralysed patients to control devices with thoughts was demonstrated by Neuralink in 2023 — 28 years later. The anime also predicted social media addiction, cyberterrorism, and AI autonomy debates. Follow for anime that read the future better than scientists.
